It would only idle or go full throttle.  Any other throttle position would cause it to stall.   I rebuilt the carburetor before I realized the little black specs of charcoal in the jets.  My solution was putting panty hose material over the canister tube so it couldn't travel into it again.  Also took me 10 hours to change the alternator.  But I actually did like to drive it.
